meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Store a dag definition once and re-run it in one or two lines, instead of pasting the full definition JSON into every eval cell. MUST USE whenever the user wants to save a DAG for reuse, run a previously saved/named DAG, schedule the same graph repeatedly (nightly/weekly audits, recurring multi-agent pipelines), or asks where to put a dag definition file. Triggers: dag library, save this dag, reuse a dag, run the saved dag, stored dag definition, recurring dag, nightly dag, dag 정의 저장, 저장된 dag 실행, dag 반복 실행, DAG 만들어두고 여러 번.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存常用流程一次，以后按名一键重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有反复要跑的流程，想存一次就能复用。
copy.tagline_en: Save a workflow once, then rerun it anytime by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have workflows you run repeatedly and want to store them once.

howto.what: 把写好的 DAG 定义存成命名文件,之后用名字一两行就能重跑,不用再贴整段 JSON。默认每次开新运行,也可指定后缀复用旧结果。
howto.when: 当你想保存 DAG 以便复用、运行已保存的 DAG、定时重复跑同一张图时触发;问定义文件该放哪、或提到“dag library”“save this dag”等词也会触发。

say.text: 把这个 DAG 存下来,以后我要能直接重跑它。
say.note: 会存成命名文件并试跑一次确认。

say.text: 运行保存过的 nightly-audit 这个 DAG。
say.note: 按名加载并启动,默认开全新一次运行。

say.text: DAG 定义文件应该放在哪里?
say.note: 会指向 OMO_DAG_LIBRARY 等库目录。

howto.what_en: Store a DAG definition once as a named JSON file, then re-run it by name without pasting the full definition. Default load rotates the key with a UTC timestamp, so each start is a fresh run; an explicit or empty suffix reuses prior runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on saving a DAG for reuse, running a saved/named DAG, or repeating the same graph on a schedule; also when asking where a dag file goes or on keywords like 'dag library'.

say_en.text: Save this DAG so I can re-run it later by name.
say_en.note: Stores it as a named JSON file and runs it once to confirm.

say_en.text: Run the saved DAG called nightly-audit.
say_en.note: Loads by name and starts a fresh run by default.

say_en.text: Where should the DAG definition file go?
